name: What are the common signs of a hidden water leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a hidden water leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden water leaks can often be detected through several subtle signs. These include an unexplained increase in your water bill, damp or discolored spots on walls, ceilings, or floors, a persistent musty odor, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. You might also notice a drop in water pressure or unusually lush patches in your yard, suggesting an underground pipe leak. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent further damage to your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for increased water bills, damp spots, musty smells, or the sound of running water. These are key indicators of a hidden leak.
